data.name: Akhil
data.gender_notes: Akhil is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Akhil is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Akha' meaning 'entire' or 'whole'. It is a powerful name that signifies completeness and perfection. In Hindu mythology, Akhil is an epithet for Lord Vishnu, who is considered the preserver of the universe. The name is believed to bring good fortune, happiness, and success to the one who bears it.
data.etymology: Akhil belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Entire, Whole, Complete.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akhil total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_significance: Akhil holds deep spiritual significance as it is associated with Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe.
